bullets.text: The Madras High Court kept the development ban around Pallikaranai marsh in force, and the office should monitor wetland protection progress.
Chennai grid delays put summer power supply at risk as transmission upgrades miss deadlines, so the office must watch for power stability.
PMK president Anbumani hailed the HC verdict on Pallikaranai marshland as a major victory, and the constituency team should track local political reactions.
Avadi police arrested three persons for land fraud involving 1.59 acres worth two crore rupees, and the district team should monitor further arrests.
Officials caught twenty-four cases of power theft in areas including Avadi and collected fines, prompting the district team to watch for utility enforcement.
Karnataka charted a one thousand megawatt data centre roadmap at the Bengaluru Tech Summit, and the portfolio team should watch competitive policy trends.
DMK leadership condemned TVK health policy proposals regarding medical services, and the office should monitor political debates on health and alcohol policy.

reports.title: Madras HC Keeps Pallikaranai Marshland’s 1-km Construction Ban

takeaways: The Madras High Court refused to quash the 1km development ban around the Pallikaranai marsh.
Builders must now approach the Supreme Court if they wish to challenge the wetland restrictions.
